newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen marking time pre-holiday.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen marking time pre-holiday.

text.p: *Stocks seen marking time ahead of holiday weekend. "I don't see much today. You may get some options business but otherwise it going to be a consolidative day," said a Sydney-based dealer.
*On Wall Street the Dow edged lower to modest losses as investors resumed their cautious ways after Tuesday's leap.
*ADRs: News Corp 18-3/4 (-1/4), BHP 26-3/4 (-1/8), WMC 24-1/4 (steady), National Australia Bank 65-7/8 (steady)
*Gold price was little changed, on LME copper pushed higher but momentum was slower than Tuesday's showing. Aluminium, nickel and zinc also firmed although lead and tin edged lower.
